registry.duplicateHelp: Flagged by name similarity — nothing is merged automatically. Rename one to match the other, or archive the one you don't want.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.subtitle: Everything attached to a Test or Clinic Visit, in one place. Files still live on their original record — deleting here removes it from there too.
attachments.empty: No attachments yet — add one from a Test or Clinic Visit.
attachments.removeConfirm: Remove "{title}"? It'll also disappear from its original {kind} record — there's no getting it back.

about.title: About
about.footer: Local-first — nothing here leaves this device unless you choose to export or share it.

dataNetwork.title: Data & network
dataNetwork.intro: SHOS is on-device only — nothing is ever sent to a server SHOS runs. Two features do call a third party directly from your device to do their job. Both are listed here exactly, and can be turned off.
dataNetwork.addressLookupDesc: “Use current location” and address autocomplete (Contacts, My Profile, Clinic Visits, Encounters) send a typed address or your GPS coordinates to OpenStreetMap’s free Nominatim service to look up a real address or place name. Off: you can still type an address by hand, just without suggestions or auto-lookup.
dataNetwork.updateCheckDesc: On the installed Android app only, checks GitHub’s public API on launch for a newer build. Reveals your IP address to GitHub, nothing else. Off: you can still check manually from the About screen.
dataNetwork.sendReportsDesc: Settings > Developer tools > Error log’s own "Report a problem" box always saves your note on-device. If you set a URL here, tapping Send there ALSO sends just that typed text to it directly — no export step, no email client, and nothing else about you or your device. Leave blank to keep it local-only.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.intro: Widgets appear on your home screen and lock screen.
widgets.nextDoseDesc: Shows medication name + next dose time
widgets.refillDueDesc: Shows count + next medication needing refill
widgets.lastTestDesc: Shows last STI test date + when a retest is due
widgets.cycleDesc: Shows cycle day, phase and next period
widgets.clinicCardDesc: Shows the next appointment, its location and test count
widgets.quickAddEncounterDesc: Tap to open Add Encounter form
widgets.quickAddContactDesc: Tap to open Add Contact form
widgets.quickAddMedicationDesc: Tap to open Log Medication form
widgets.shortcutOnly: Shortcut only — no data to hide
widgets.privacyNoteBody: Widgets are visible on the lock screen without authentication.

notifHistory.title: Notification history
notifHistory.clearConfirm: This clears the whole notification history — there's no getting it back.
notifHistory.empty: Nothing's fired yet. Real reminders (and the test notification) show up here the moment they actually deliver.
